summary: No findings. AC#1: /proc/<pid>/comm (settable by any local process, max 15 bytes) -> processName() -> holderText() now replaces [\x00-\x1f\x7f] with '?', so CR/LF cannot begin a new log line; the two sinks (apt-lock.js:143 plain log, :240 inside an existing ::error:: message) therefore cannot emit a new ::add-mask::/::set-output::/::error:: command. A '::' or '%0A' inside the name stays within the ::error:: message data (the runner only parses properties before the first '::', and %-unescaping affects annotation text, not command parsing), so no reachable injection remains. The Actions runner splits lines on CR/LF only, so C1/Unicode separators (NEL, U+2028) are not a path. sudo install step (ci.yml): fixed repo-tracked source, fixed destination, mode 0644, no expressions or user input interpolated; on pull_request the PR author already controls the workflow and has passwordless sudo on the ephemeral runner, so it grants no new privilege; token stays contents: read. apt-network.conf only sets timeouts/retries and does not weaken transport security. No new dependencies, secrets, or randomness. devParts mask change is a correctness change with no security impact.
